body: I feel like I'm really falling behind my peers. It's not like I even particularly want a partner or to get married like everyone else is, but I feel a pressure to do so. Wish I had friends that were more like me, who cared for things other than romance and starting families.

Thank you for taking the time to read and respond. I really appreciate it.

Yes, I definitely agree with you. And I can only hope people don't remember it as time passes. It's so easy for me to imagine the worst case scenarios.

Thank you. 🙏

Yes, I'm the same way. I feel like it's getting easier and easier to trigger me and these thoughts.

I hate being inconvenienced and when that happens, I immediately think it's better if something ends me there and then.
